growing_temperature.note: 60–90°F growing-season range; extremes can slow growth, pollination, and maturation.

requirements: Well-drained soil and consistent moisture are important.
Avoid large moisture swings during fruit growth.
Use soil-test results before making fertilizer decisions.
Flowering and fruit set are sensitive to heat and cool nights.

sources.title: Penn State Extension — Tomatoes: From Seedlings to Fruit
